name: page-studio
description: Page work for the Site Editor in focused skills: page-audit (read-only gap analysis), page-create (new pages and sections), page-edit-content (words, images, links) and page-edit-design (layout, order, style), behind a thin page-studio front door. Each editing skill captures a baseline, verifies on the rendered page and pushes only to the staging theme (never live; publishing only when asked, with two confirmations), with the Shopify CLI or, when it isn't installed, through the Shopify connector.
